title: PointPillars: Fast Encoders for Object Detection from Point Clouds
grouping: Top row: input point-cloud render -> three grey rounded network boxes -> output render with boxes, with bold headings 'Point cloud' and 'Predictions' above the renders. Bottom row: two dashed rounded containers, each tied to its top-row box by two thin grey lines spreading downward like a zoom: the left expands the pillar encoder, the right the 2-D backbone.
shapes_depth: Top-row modules are large light-grey rounded boxes with bold two-line labels. Detail panels draw tensors as white 3-D blocks with grey side faces and axis arrows labelled with their dimensions (D, P, N; C, P; C, H, W; and H/2, W/2, 2C style sizes in the backbone), with operations written on the arrows (Conv, Deconv, Concat). The point clouds are coloured LiDAR renders; predictions are blue and red 3-D box wireframes on the render.
proposed_highlight: Orange is reserved for one pillar traced through the encoder detail: the column in the point cloud, its slab in the stacked tensor, its feature column, its pixel in the pseudo-image, and a thin orange line from the pillar-index bar to that pixel.
lesson: Trace one pillar through the encoder in a single accent colour (orange): the column standing on the point cloud, its slab in the stacked tensor, its feature column and its pixel in the pseudo-image, while all other tensor bulk stays white and grey.
notes: Venue CVPR as recorded by Semantic Scholar (venue_source: semantic-scholar); year = arXiv preprint year (1812.05784) and S2 year; the conference year was not confirmed by anything read.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: a four-step overview row of large grey rounded boxes (Pillar Feature Net -> Backbone (2D CNN) -> Detection Head (SSD)) between input and output lidar renders, with the first two boxes opened into dashed rounded panels below, tied by pairs of funnel lines from each box's bottom edge

relations.form: the top row runs left to right on one straight axis: point-cloud render -> three grey stage boxes -> prediction render with blue/red 3D boxes

the Pillar Feature Net panel follows one orange pillar through every tensor: an orange column on the ground plane -> an orange slab in the D x P x N stacked pillars -> an orange column in the C x P learned features -> an orange cell in the C x H x W pseudo image
a thin 'Pillar Index' strip with one orange cell runs under the panel and an orange line rises from it to the pillar's cell in the pseudo image, showing the scatter back to grid position
the backbone panel draws a top-down cascade of three shrinking cuboids (C, 2C, 4C at H/2, H/4, H/8) each sent right by a Deconv arrow to equal-size cuboids, then concatenated into one 6C cuboid
the three Deconv outputs' lines converge from the right into a stacked 6C cuboid labeled Concat

channels.colour: orange = the one pillar being tracked, used in every tensor of the first panel and on the index line; everything else is grey/white; grey fill on the overview boxes marks stages; colour has one meaning
channels.shape: rounded grey boxes = stages, 3-D cuboids with C/H/W/P/N axes = tensors, lidar renders = input and output
channels.line: solid grey arrows = data flow; thin grey funnel lines = zoom from a stage to its panel; an orange line = pillar index lookup
channels.frame: dashed rounded panels = the inside of one stage

quality.strengths: the novel encoding (points -> pillars -> pseudo image) is drawn on the data with one orange pillar traced through every tensor, so the scatter to a 2D grid reads as geometry; tensors are shaped cuboids with labeled axes; the overview axis is straight and each zoom panel sits under the box it expands
quality.weaknesses: the backbone panel is cramped, with H/2, W/2, 2C labels overlapping cuboid edges; the backbone (a standard 2D CNN) gets as much panel area as the pillar encoding; the Detection Head is never opened and no anchor or loss is shown; funnel lines from the Backbone box cross diagonally into a panel offset to the right

insights.structure: Top row is a four-step pipeline of large grey rounded boxes (Pillar Feature Net, Backbone (2D CNN), Detection Head (SSD)) between input and output lidar renders; below, two dashed rounded panels expand the first two boxes, joined to them by funnel lines.
insights.data: Input and predictions are real lidar renders (predictions with blue/red 3D boxes); intermediate tensors are 3-D cuboids with C/H/W/P axes, the pillar is an orange bar, and a pillar-index strip routes features into the pseudo image.
insights.emphasis: Orange marks the single pillar through every tensor in the Pillar Feature Net panel, letting the reader follow one pillar from points to pseudo-image.
insights.flow: Top row left to right; funnel lines drop from stage boxes to their zoom panels, which also read left to right (the backbone panel top-down then right via Deconv/Concat).
insights.avoid: The backbone zoom panel crowds small cuboids, labels like 2C, H/2, W/2 overlap the box edges, and the detection head gets no expansion.

arrangement.units: top row of grey stage boxes; below them dashed rounded zoom panels for stage 1 and stage 2, connected by funnel lines
arrangement.inputs_as: real lidar point-cloud render titled 'Point cloud'
